question: Identify the antonym of "Venerable":
solution:
The correct answer is: **Immature**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"Venerable"** means someone or something that deserves respect due to age, wisdom, or character. (आदरणीय)
 
 
 
• **Example:** The venerable professor was admired by all his students for his vast knowledge.
 
 
 
• **"Immature"** refers to someone or something that is not fully developed or lacks the qualities associated with maturity, such as wisdom or responsibility. (अपरिपक्व)
